subject: Unexpected usage spike after sandbox rollout
summary: Customer reports a 35 percent usage increase after enabling isolated execution for support workflows.

messages.author: customer
messages.body: We enabled sandbox isolation last week and our usage dashboard jumped. Can you help us understand whether this is expected?

messages.author: support
messages.body: We are checking execution counts and sandbox lifecycle events for the affected tenant.

policy_notes: Acknowledge the impact before explaining likely causes.
Do not promise a refund without billing approval.
Offer to review usage analytics with the customer.

subject: Question about exporting audit logs
summary: Customer wants to know whether their current plan supports audit log export.

messages.author: customer
messages.body: Can our team export audit logs for quarterly review?

policy_notes: Do not expose details from other tenants.
Suggest upgrade path only if the feature is unavailable.
